name: forge/github-create-branch
description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository, optionally from a specific base branch or commit. Requires the GITHUB_TOKEN secret and Daedalus's github_create_branch builtin (ships with the backend).

tool.name: github_create_branch
tool.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository. Defaults to branching from the repository's default branch. Fails if the branch already exists.

owner.description: GitHub owner or organization of the repository

branch.description: Name of the new branch to create

base.description: Branch or commit SHA to branch from; defaults to the repository's default branch
